entities.summary: Lionel Allen Sheldon was appointed a brigadier general in the Ohio militia in 1858 by Governor Salmon P Chase and served as an officer in the Union Army during the American Civil War. A U.S. Representative from Louisiana. He was appointed the governor of New Mexico Territory by President James Garfield and served in that role from 1881 until he resigned in 1885.
